=== Publication sources ===
* '''Source publication''' ([[Failure At The Cave (V)]]): Card image first published 9 November 2020<ref name="v0-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/1fa635b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Dark/Large/Failure%20At%20The%20Cave.gif Failure At The Cave.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/1fa635b 1fa635b] (9 November 2020, “virtual set 13 cards”).</ref>: “Plays on table. Opponent's Undercover spies are immune to Double Agent. While a Jedi Test on table, Projection Of A Skywalker is canceled. If Grimtaash just revealed your hand, you may place up to two cards from hand in your Used Pile.” Printed: no errata mark; lower-left name “Failure At The Cave”. Published on the day [[Virtual Set 13]] was released (9 November 2020); the same image was committed again unchanged later that day (“Set 13 Title Updates”) and on 17 December 2020 (folder moves).
* '''Source publication''' ([[Failure At The Cave (V) (Remastered)]]): Card image published 3 January 2023<ref name="v1-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/11d5d80/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Dark/large/failureatthecave.gif failureatthecave.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/11d5d80 11d5d80] (3 January 2023, “Fixing case and making gifs”); high-resolution image <code>Virtual13-Dark/hires/failureatthecave.png</code>, commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/fba281d fba281d] (2 January 2023, “Remastered Sets 13 and P, and 1 AI fix.”).</ref>: “Plays on table. Opponent's Undercover spies are immune to Double Agent. While a Jedi Test on table, Projection Of A Skywalker is canceled. If Grimtaash just revealed your hand, you may place up to two cards from hand in your Used Pile.” Printed: no errata mark; lower-left name “Failure At The Cave”. '''What changed:''' re-rendered by the PC in its remastered card style (high-resolution image committed 2 January 2023 as “Remastered Sets 13 and P”); same words. The straight apostrophe in “Opponent's” is now a curly one (“Opponent’s”). No errata mark. 
* '''Source publication''' (this page): Card image published 22 July 2024<ref name="v2-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/6c22b09/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Dark/large/failureatthecave.gif failureatthecave.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6c22b09 6c22b09] (22 July 2024, “Fixing case and making gifs”); high-resolution image <code>Virtual13-Dark/hires/failureatthecave.png</code>, commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/a546b30 a546b30] (21 July 2024, “Set 23 Errata”).</ref>: “Plays on table. Stone Pile is canceled. While a Jedi Test on table, opponent may not reduce your Force drains. Unless opponent has deployed a battleground, Domain Of Evil may not modify destiny draws more than once per battle.” Printed: marked “E1”; lower-left name “Failure At The Cave”. '''What changed:''' PC errata released with [[Virtual Set 23]] and the July 2024 Defensive Shield Update Kit<ref name="dskit2024">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DShieldUpdateKit_2024_July.pdf July 2024 Defensive Shield Update Kit] (PDF, 3 pages, “SWCCG Players Committee, July 2024”; file built 2 August 2024), released with [[Virtual Set 23]] (22 July 2024).</ref> (image marked “E1”): the game text after “Plays on table.” is replaced: “Stone Pile is canceled. While a Jedi Test on table, opponent may not reduce your Force drains. Unless opponent has deployed a battleground, Domain Of Evil may not modify destiny draws more than once per battle.” The printed errata mark (“E1”) does not match this version's place in the release order (change 2 of this card): recorded as a [[Players Committee transcription errors#Errata marks that do not match the version (Virtual Modern)|PC transcription error]].
* '''Source publication''' ([[Failure At The Cave (V) (Errata)]]): Partial slip in the July 2024 Defensive Shield Update Kit<ref name="dskit2024-slip">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DShieldUpdateKit_2024_July.pdf July 2024 Defensive Shield Update Kit] (PDF, 3 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, July 2024”; file created 2 August 2024), page 1: partial slip labelled “•Failure At The Cave”. Released with [[Virtual Set 23]] (22 July 2024); the PDF itself is dated by its creation date.</ref>: “Plays on table. Stone Pile is canceled. While a Jedi Test on table, opponent may not reduce your Force drains. Unless opponent has deployed a battleground, Domain Of Evil may not modify destiny draws more than once per battle.” '''What changed:''' Same words as the 22 July 2024 card image ([[Failure At The Cave (V) (Errata)]]). The kit prints the card as a partial slip — the title bar and lore, a blank white area where the picture is, and the game-text box — with the lower-left name and the errata mark “E1” at the bottom, to be laid over a printed card. A separate PC publication that looks visibly different from the card image, so a version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication and every visible change is a version). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints “E1” but is errata 3 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
